text:
Cel Pedire Thanks for posting this. I’m in a very similar situation.

My A/5 expired on June 3, and the Hadera MOI office only gave me an appointment for mid-August. We even went there in person to ask for an extension at least until the appointment date, but I was not allowed inside. Only my Israeli partner was allowed in, and he was immediately sent away by security. They told him there are hundreds of people in the same situation and that we should “complain to the Prime Minister.”

I’m planning to bring fully updated documents to the appointment to avoid any further delays.

How did you manage to solve the Bituach Leumi issue? They already sent me a letter saying I have a 45-day grace period to regularize my residency status, otherwise I may lose my national insurance/health coverage.
